map.净水器滤芯寿命计算使用指南：说明额定净水量、每日净水用量、水质系数与安全余量的计: Water Filter Lifespan Calculator Guide: explains rated capacity, daily filtered water use, water-quality factor and safety margin, with examples for usable days, replacement date, cartridges per year and annual cost, plus replacement signals for RO, PP cotton and carbon filters.
map.净水器滤芯寿命计算器按滤芯额定净水量、每日净水用量、水质等级、安全余量与滤芯价格: The Water Filter Lifespan Calculator estimates usable days, replacement date, cartridges per year and annual cost from rated capacity, daily filtered water use, water quality, safety margin and cartridge price, helping households plan replacements and budgets.
map.有效净水量 Q = 额定净水量 × 水质系数 × 安全余量；可用天数 T = Q: Effective water volume Q = rated capacity × water-quality factor × safety margin; usable days T = Q ÷ daily filtered water use; replacements per year N = 365 ÷ T; annual cost C = N × cartridge price. Water-quality factors are 1.0 (good), 0.85 (average) and 0.70 (poor); the default 90% safety margin replaces the cartridge before capacity runs out.
map.在滤芯包装或说明书中找到“额定净水量”，单位是升则直接填入，单位是吨则乘以 10: Find the rated capacity on the cartridge box or manual; enter liters directly, or multiply tonnes by 1000.
map.统计每天经过该滤芯的水量：饮用、煮饭、煲汤、洗菜都算；只算饮用水会明显低估。: Count all water passing through the filter each day: drinking, cooking, soup and washing vegetables. Counting drinking water alone will significantly underestimate use.
map.按当地水质选“较好 / 一般 / 较差”，再设安全余量。水质差或对口感敏感时，余: Choose good, average or poor water quality for your area, then set the safety margin. For poor water or taste sensitivity, use 80%-85%.
map.填入滤芯单价和开始使用日期，点击计算，得到可用天数、更换日期和年均成本；需要采购: Enter the cartridge price and start date, then calculate to get usable days, replacement date and annual cost; export CSV when you need a record for purchasing.
map.家庭换芯提醒：提前知道哪个月该换哪一级滤芯，避免临时买错型号。: Household replacement reminders: know which month each filter stage is due, avoiding a rushed purchase of the wrong model.
map.租房/小户型：用水少时按时间上限换芯，不要只看额定净水量。: Renters and small homes: with low water use, replace by the time limit rather than waiting for rated capacity to run out.
map.水质较差地区：按较差水质折减，并考虑加装前置 PP 棉保护 RO 膜。: Poor water quality areas: apply the poor-quality factor and consider a pre-filter PP cotton stage to protect the RO membrane.
map.额定净水量 4000 L、每天 8 L、市政自来水（系数 0.85）、安全余量: Rated capacity 4000 L, 8 L/day, municipal tap water (factor 0.85), 90% safety margin: effective water volume 3060 L, about 383 usable days, about 0.95 cartridge per year; at CNY 120 per cartridge, annual cost is about CNY 114 and cost per liter about CNY 0.039.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入不上传服务器，结果仅作换芯预算参考。实际寿命受进水 TDS: This tool runs entirely in the browser, uploads no inputs, and is for replacement budgeting only. Actual life depends on feed TDS, chlorine, hardness, temperature, peak use and cartridge quality; replace early if flow slows, odor appears or TDS rejection drops. When rated capacity and the maker's interval conflict, use whichever comes first.
map.额定净水量和厂商建议周期冲突时听谁的？: What if rated capacity conflicts with the maker's replacement interval?
map.以先到者为准。额定净水量是容量上限，厂商建议的 6–12 个月是时间上限；即使水: Whichever comes first. Rated capacity is the volume limit and the maker's 6-12 months is the time limit; even with capacity left, long soaking can breed bacteria or saturate the media.
map.水质系数为什么不是固定的？: Why isn't the water-quality factor fixed?
map.市政自来水的余氯、泥沙和硬度差异很大。水质差时滤芯更快堵塞或饱和，因此按较好 1: Municipal tap water varies widely in chlorine, sediment and hardness. Poor water clogs or saturates the cartridge faster, so factors of 1.0, 0.85 and 0.70 are applied.
map.RO 膜也要按这个算吗？: Should RO membranes use this too?
map.可以按额定净水量估算，但 RO 膜还受进水 TDS、温度和产水量影响。若 TDS: Yes, estimate by rated capacity, but RO membranes also depend on feed TDS, temperature and permeate flow. Replace early if TDS rejection drops or permeate flow falls.
